title: pvVisItPLOT3DReader
body:
## pvVisItPLOT3DReader

Reads NASA PLOT3D structured grid (.x) and solution (.q) files described by a VisIt .vp3d text meta file. The output is a curvilinear "mesh" with one domain per grid and node-centred solution variables. The native pvPLOT3DReader (properties for each variant) and pvPLOT3DMetaFileReader (JSON .p3d time series) are normally preferable. FileName takes a list of files, each one time step of a series (ParaView's file-series wrapper).

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Describe the variant in the .vp3d file; otherwise the defaults (C binary, 3-D, single grid, big-endian, single precision) are assumed and other files are misread.
- Name the arrays you need in PointArrayStatus and CellArrayStatus: the VisIt bridge starts with every variable unselected, so omitting them normally gives geometry without fields.
- The VisIt plugin's own read options stay at their defaults; the ParaView proxy exposes no property to change them.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue and has not run a native acceptance check for this reader; check meshes, arrays and times on your own data.

Native constructor: `VisItPLOT3DReader`. Identity: `sources/VisItPLOT3DReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CellArrayStatus` | Names of the zone-centred (cell) variables to read from PLOT3D data; each becomes a cell-data array on every selected mesh that defines it. Vector variables arrive as one multi-component array, while VisIt expressions and tensor, label, species and array variables are not converted by the bridge. The PLOT3D plugin declares its variables node-centred, so this list normally stays empty. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `FileName` | The list of files to be read by the reader. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"items":{"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"minItems":1,"type":"array"}` | `required` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `MaterialStatus` | Names of materials to convert into volume-fraction cell arrays. For each selected material the bridge adds a float cell array named after it: 1 in cells made only of that material, its volume fraction in mixed cells and -1 where it is absent. The PLOT3D plugin defines no materials, so this list has nothing to select. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `MeshStatus` | Names of the PLOT3D meshes to read. Each selected mesh becomes one named block of the multiblock output and unlisted meshes are skipped. The PLOT3D plugin reports one curvilinear mesh named "mesh", with one domain per grid. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `PointArrayStatus` | Names of the node-centred (point) variables to read from PLOT3D data; each becomes a point-data array on every selected mesh that defines it. Vector variables arrive as one multi-component array, while VisIt expressions and tensor, label, species and array variables are not converted by the bridge. For PLOT3D data these are the node-centred PLOT3D solution variables (density, momentum, energy and derived quantities such as Mach number). | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvVisItPLOT3DReader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": [
      "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
    ]
  }
}
```
